summary: #2223: composite foreign keys as `sv.references(*cols, to=...)`, mirroring `sv.key(*cols)`, with MATCH SIMPLE (a row with any NULL part is exempt); one condition per pair is unsound and is never read that way.
note: Refusals R1-R5 at build time. `References` fields become tuples with no aliases (a changelog break). Lean's ForeignKeys stays one-column, and the reader skips longer entries explicitly; the composite rewrite in fkMatch is nice to have. No D-number.
